review_notes: I read the whole file. It has four existence/equality theorems and no simp attributes, definitions or rewrite rules. I checked the Mathlib sources for ContinuousMap.sigmaMk and Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_map. I found no competing simp rules, no unsuitable rewrite direction, no unwanted expansion and no credible loop. The theorems are existential or return `z.1 = i` for a free `z`, so they are not natural simp lemmas. The module doc explains why the anonymous bundled map is used instead of `ContinuousMap.sigmaMk`, so that is a deliberate choice. I did not look at downstream uses outside this file, so a simp-related issue there is possible but not supported by anything I read.
